status: Unreviewed AI drafts for fixed app controls. No fluent-speaker approval. Glyphs move to semantic Lucide markup; words, operation callbacks, placeholders, source qualifications and numeric inputs remain protected.

entries.english: Sun: strongest from the {direction} — put your beds on that side.
entries.zu: Ilanga linamandla kakhulu {direction} — beka imibhede yakho ngakulolo hlangothi.
entries.st: Letsatsi le matla haholo ho tswa {direction} — beha dibethe tsa hao ka lehlakoreng leo.
entries.ts: Dyambu ri ni ntamu swinene ku suka {direction} — veka mibedo ya wena eka tlhelo rero.
entries.ve: Ḓuvha ḽi na maanḓa nga maanḓa u bva {direction} — vheani mibethe yaṋu kha sia ḽeneḽo.

entries.english: Coordinate climate-grid mean: wind FROM the {directions}. Confirm on site.
entries.zu: Isilinganiso segridi yesimo sezulu kulezi zixhumanisi: umoya UVELA {directions}. Qinisekisa endaweni.
entries.st: Karolelano ya gridi ya maemo a lehodimo sebakeng sa dikhokahanyo: moya O TSWA {directions}. Netefatsa setsheng.
entries.ts: Avhareji ya giridi ya maxelo eka tikhodinati leti: moya WU HUMA {directions}. Tiyisisa endhawini.
entries.ve: Ndinganyelo ya giridi ya kilima kha khoudinethe idzi: muya U BVA {directions}. Khwaṱhisedzani fhethu.

entries.english: Water flows downhill to the {direction} — swales go ACROSS that flow{frost}.
entries.zu: Amanzi ageleza ehla {direction}; ama-swale (imisele yokubamba amanzi) anqamula le ndlela{frost}.
entries.st: Metsi a phalla a theohela {direction} — diforo tse tshwarang metsi di TSHELA phallo eo{frost}.
entries.ts: Mati ma khuluka ma rhelela {direction} — misele yo khoma mati yi TLULA ndlela ya ku khuluka koloko{frost}.
entries.ve: Maḓi a elela a tshi tsela {direction} — migero ya u fara maḓi i PFUKA u elela honoho{frost}.

entries.st: Tobetsa dikgutlo, ebe o kgetha Qetella
entries.ts: Thinta tikhona, kutani u hlawula Hetisa
entries.ve: Kwamani khuḓa, ni kone u nanga Fhedzisani

entries.zu: Yenza ikhophi yento noma izinto ezikhethiwe — Cmd/Ctrl+D
entries.st: Etsa khopi ya ntho kapa dintho tse kgethilweng — Cmd/Ctrl+D
entries.ts: Endla khopi ya nchumu kumbe swilo leswi hlawuriweke — Cmd/Ctrl+D
entries.ve: Itani khophi ya tshithu kana zwithu zwo nangwaho — Cmd/Ctrl+D

entries.english: Preview a tidied version of the selected outline
entries.zu: Buka kuqala inguqulo elungisiwe yomugqa wangaphandle okhethiwe
entries.st: Sheba pele mofuta o lokisitsweng wa mola wa ka ntle o kgethilweng
entries.ts: Languta ku sungula layini ya le handle leyi hlawuriweke leyi lulamisiweke
entries.ve: Lavhelesani u thoma mutalo wa nnḓa wo nangwaho wo lugiswaho

entries.english: Preview closing hairline seams with a neighbouring zone
entries.zu: Buka kuqala ukuvalwa kwezikhala ezincane kakhulu phakathi kwendawo ekhethiwe nenye eseduze
entries.st: Sheba pele ho kwalwa ha dikgeo tse tshesane haholo pakeng tsa zoune le e pela yona
entries.ts: Languta ku sungula ku pfariwa ka mavangwa lamatsongo swinene ni zoni leyi nga ekusuhi
entries.ve: Lavhelesani u thoma u valwa ha zwikhala zwiṱukusa na zouni i re tsini

entries.english: Preview straightening and evenly spacing the selected items
entries.zu: Buka kuqala ukuqondiswa kwezinto ezikhethiwe nokushiywa kwezikhala ezilinganayo phakathi kwazo
entries.st: Sheba pele ho otlollwa le ho siuwa ha dikgeo tse lekanang pakeng tsa dintho tse kgethilweng
entries.ts: Languta ku sungula ku ololoxiwa ni ku vekiwa ka mavangwa yo ringana eka swilo leswi hlawuriweke
entries.ve: Lavhelesani u thoma u otlollwa na u vhewa ha zwikhala zwi eḓanaho kha zwithu zwo nangwaho

entries.ts: Xiyimo xa ndzilo xa ndhawu: {season} Wu nga tshinela ku suka {direction} — tiyisisa endhawini.
entries.ve: Nyimele ya mulilo ya dzingu: {season} U nga sendela u bva {direction} — khwaṱhisedzani henefho.

entries.english: north in winter, south in summer
entries.ts: n'walungu hi xixika, dzonga hi ximumu

entries.english: · frost settles low there on still, cold nights

entries.ve: · ṅwando u dzula fhasi henefho nga vhusiku vhu rotholelaho vhu si na muya

entries.zu: Qala ngokuvula le ndawo ebalazweni ukuze ubone amandla ayo.

entries.ve: Vulani fhethu afha kha mapa u thoma uri ni vhale maanḓa aho.

notes: A glyph is presentation, never the translated action identity. Source English changes only remove icon code points; the application renders the same operation with an aria-hidden Lucide SVG.
The earlier isiZulu confirmation strings duplicated the English clause/placeholders. Native controls now carry one translated action. Unchanged native clauses are preserved exactly.

Wind wording retains the actual English coordinate climate-grid mean and on-site confirmation qualification. Sector model calculations, geometry and source data do not change. Model-owned provenance/season text may still be English; this is not a complete Design Studio translation claim.
Historical guards may reverse only this complete exact declared UI layer. Changed, partial or extra learning content must still fail the original hashes.
